patches.purpose: For persistent local folders, compare original disk bytes immediately before and during an exclusive per-file write. Keep an externally changed disk file and the browser draft, report a distinct conflict, and carry the known previous version through FileStore, directory imports, Git worktree operations and a folder-permission interruption. Each browser tab records the content it actually opened instead of substituting a newer shared IndexedDB value as its disk-write baseline. While folder permission is pending, persist only the first observed disk content for each changed file in the existing project database, restore it before reconnecting the folder, and remove it after a successful disk write. This is a narrow conditional-write baseline, not a general journal, project snapshot or cloud draft service. Preserve the inherited account-mode write behavior and the existing browser compiler scheduler.

Its v1-to-v2 IndexedDB regression retains existing project files while adding the baseline store. Actual Chromium 149 closed the whole browser twice while permission was absent, recovered the browser draft, and used the browser-owned reauthorization prompt: unchanged disk bytes accepted the recovered draft, while a synthetic external edit retained both versions and surfaced a visible conflict. Both branches made zero external requests. Actual two-tab Chromium also retained the newer tab's disk version and the stale tab's browser draft. Browser File System Access does not provide an atomic directory transaction or lock against every other program.

patches.purpose: Pin every downloaded public archive by exact URL, size and SHA-256; download into private staging, verify a reviewed extracted inventory and atomically install rather than trusting nonempty directories. Resolve GitHub Release metadata with retrying curl HEAD requests while disabling automatic redirects and allowlisting every hop. Large Release CDN assets use at most eight exact Range parts only after that redirect walk; every part must return 206 with its exact size, and the reassembled archive still passes the original whole-file size and SHA-256 gate. Other sources retain the single-stream path. Register same-origin Typst fonts as the complete default set so typst.ts cannot inject jsDelivr fonts. Use reviewed browser-only BusyTeX and the fixed TeX Live 2026 endpoint for every engine offered by the Rinspace selector; migrate saved legacy SwiftLaTeX selections to XeTeX 2026 while retaining the upstream Swift implementation below the product UI. Install a content-addressed CJK fallback only when the complete endpoint is unavailable. Assemble Vite, PWA and assets under /editor. Record real mirror qualification and failure decisions without enabling an unqualified browser endpoint.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream supplies exact archive and extracted-tree verification, same-origin Typst font loading and a qualified configurable asset source without implicit public-service traffic.
patches.integrationStatus: Seven of seven source archives have measured byte and extracted-inventory locks; all six default runtime trees pass warm verification. The fixed TeX Live 2026 source release is now indexed as 180,810 regular texmf-dist files: a 1,992,353,680-byte immutable pack and 38,843,725-byte basename/format index, with stable tex/latex preferred over tex/latex-dev on collisions. The server only returns verified immutable slices with one active decompression; compilation remains in the browser. Actual Chromium UI compilation passed ctexart, ctexbook, ctexrep, ctexbeamer, TikZ, Chinese text, Libertinus, TeX Gyre Termes by filename and STIX Two Math; a warm repeat made zero runtime requests. After a legacy Swift XeTeX regression was reproduced, a production candidate migrated userdata 1.3.7 `xetex` to `busytex-xetex`, exposed only the three BusyTeX engines in settings, compile and export selectors, and compiled the reported article/ctex/Chinese source through the fixed runtime with ctex, xeCJK and Fandol responses successful and no external request. Typst compilation still used 128 same-origin font requests with no external request. Alibaba and Tencent failed runtime CORS qualification; Huawei remains disabled for missing operator/terms and protocol evidence. No third-party mirror is runtime-enabled. Public release and private production consumption remain separate gates.

Chromium then compiled the same Chinese multi-file project online, closed completely, reopened the retained browser project, enabled forced-offline mode and compiled again; no external request occurred and the two cache namespaces held 72 entries.
